description: A 1HP envelope generator that runs either as an ADSR or as an attack and release pair, with a VCA of its own built in

params.text: Switches the envelope between its ADSR shape and a two stage attack and release shape
Repeats the envelope from the start as long as it is held, and works only while the two stage attack and release shape is selected
Sets the base level the envelope starts from and returns to, 0 to 1
Scales the envelope output, -2 to +2, with negative values turning it upside down
Sets the attack time, the climb from the base level to the top
Sets the decay time, the fall from the top to the sustain level
Sets the sustain level the envelope holds while the gate is up
Sets the release time, the fall back to the base level

inputs.text: A gate or trigger starts the envelope; the envelope runs its release once a gate falls
A voltage added to the attack time
A voltage added to the decay time
A voltage added to the sustain level
A voltage added to the release time
The signal into the built in VCA, which the envelope controls

outputs.text: The signal from the built in VCA, the input scaled by the envelope
A pulse at the end of the envelope

menu: EXPONENTIAL MODE (on - off) — curves the stages exponentially rather than running them as straight lines
Envelope Goes To Zero when TRIGGED/GATED — restarts the envelope from zero on a new trigger instead of from the level it had reached
Envelope Triggerable Only When Stable — ignores a new trigger until the envelope has finished
Time Ranges — a submenu of Time Range: 1 second, Time Range: 10 second and Time Range: 100 second, setting the full span of the four time knobs
